name: io.github.j-256/discord-mcp
title: Discord MCP
description: Least-privilege Discord reads, privacy-safe audits, and reviewed administration

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token sent only to fixed Discord REST and vetted Gateway origins

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_APPLICATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Expected Discord application ID; startup rejects a token for another application

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_BOT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Expected Discord bot user ID; startup rejects a token for another bot

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_GUILD_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma- or whitespace-separated read guild allowlist

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_CHANNEL_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma- or whitespace-separated read channel allowlist

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_TOOL_SURFACE
environmentVariables.description: Advertise every selected canonical tool or reveal exact tools progressively through MCP list-change notifications

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated risk-separated MCP toolsets: activity, attachments, audit-logs, automod, bans, channel-creation, channel-metadata, connector, deletion, forum-posts, gateway, guild-expressions, guild-scaffolds, guilds, interactions, invites, member-roles, members, messages, moderation, observability, onboarding, permission-overwrites, permissions, pins, role-creation, roles, scheduled-events, threads, webhooks, or all

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_GATEWAY
environmentVariables.description: Enable a scoped, content-free Gateway event feed with only nonprivileged intents

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_GATEWAY_EVENT_BUFFER_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Process-local content-free Gateway event capacity from 1 through 1000

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_OBSERVABILITY_EXPORT
environmentVariables.description: Enable manual privacy-safe OTLP trace and metric export

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_OBSERVABILITY_LOGS
environmentVariables.description: Emit one-line privacy-safe operational JSON records to stderr

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Credential-free base collector URL; HTTPS is required except for loopback

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Credential-free exact OTLP trace endpoint overriding the base URL

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Credential-free exact OTLP metric endpoint overriding the base URL

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Percent-encoded collector authentication headers shared by traces and metrics

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Percent-encoded collector authentication headers overriding shared trace headers

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Percent-encoded collector authentication headers overriding shared metric headers

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: Shared OTLP protocol; this connector accepts only http/protobuf

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: Trace OTLP protocol override; this connector accepts only http/protobuf

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: Metric OTLP protocol override; this connector accepts only http/protobuf

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_COMPRESSION
environmentVariables.description: Shared OTLP request compression

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_COMPRESSION
environmentVariables.description: Trace request compression overriding the shared setting

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_COMPRESSION
environmentVariables.description: Metric request compression overriding the shared setting

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Shared OTLP export timeout from 1 through 60000 milliseconds

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Trace export timeout overriding the shared setting

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Metric export timeout overriding the shared setting

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Safe service name without snowflake-like numeric identifiers

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
environmentVariables.description: Bounded OpenTelemetry trace sampler

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG
environmentVariables.description: Trace ID sampling ratio from 0 through 1

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_ADMINISTRATION
environmentVariables.description: Enable reviewed member administration when an exact guild allowlist is also set

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_ATTACHMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Enable reviewed local-file attachment messages when exact channel and canonical directory scopes are also set

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ATTACHMENT_CHANNEL_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Exact channel or thread IDs eligible for reviewed local-file attachment messages

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Per-file byte ceiling from 1 through Discord's default 10 MiB limit

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ATTACHMENT_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: One absolute canonical directory or a JSON array of directories whose owned regular files may be reviewed for upload

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ADMIN_GUILD_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Exact guild IDs eligible for reviewed member administration

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_PROTECTED_USER_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Exact user IDs that member administration and member-role changes must never target

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_MEMBER_DIRECTORY

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_MEMBER_DIRECTORY_GUILD_IDS

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_BAN_AUDIT_GUILD_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Exact guild IDs eligible for privacy-minimized ban audit

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_MEMBER_ROLE_GUILD_IDS

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_MEMBER_ROLE_IDS

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_CHANNEL_CREATION

environmentVariables.description: Enable reviewed public forum-post creation when an exact forum-channel allowlist is also set
